nv-county-officials.area: Nevada — all 16 counties and Carson City
nv-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the office looking empty.
nv-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Nevada's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
nv-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

nv-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City card names the city you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
nv-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Nevada's cities has been read for this app, and the cities' own pages have not been read one by one.
nv-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's mayor and council members, or a city's own published list of them.

nv-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its board of trustees.
nv-school-board-members.why: No list of the trustees of Nevada's school districts has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
nv-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's trustees, or a district's own published list of its board.

nv-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the council of nine of Nevada's 20 nations, from each nation's own page. For each of the other eleven it says why it names nobody.
nv-tribal-government.why: Four of those nations' pages leave out part of their council or list a seat as vacant, and a partial council is not carried. Others name nobody, refused this project, or have no site this project found.
nv-tribal-government.wanted: A council list from each of the other eleven nations that this project may read, naming every member.
